files.label: Supplementary Tables 1–9
files.caption: Supplementary Table 1. Harmonized metadata of samples analyzed. Supplementary Table 2. Cell Ranger QC outputs for all newly generated data. Supplementary Table 3. Absolute cell counts per donor and dataset in the HECA. Supplementary Table 4. Cell–cell interactions identified using LIANA. Supplementary Table 5. Differentially expressed genes reported for stromal cells between controls and endometriosis cases. Differential expression analysis was performed using limma v.3.54.2. The table reports the magnitude of differential expression (log2 fold change) and false discovery rate-adjusted P values using the Benjamini–Hochberg method. Supplementary Table 6. Differentially expressed genes reported for macrophages between controls and endometriosis cases. Differential expression analysis was performed using limma v.3.54.2. The table reports the magnitude of differential expression (log2 fold change) and false discovery rate-adjusted P values using the Benjamini–Hochberg method. Supplementary Table 7. Reagents used for the snRNA-seq homogenization buffer. Supplementary Table 8. Reagents used for the snRNA-seq wash buffer. Supplementary Table 9. List of smFISH probes used for smFISH imagining.

prose.description: Supplementary PDF for a human endometrial and cervical atlas study. Contains integrated cell-state identification, detailed annotation sections for epithelial and stromal cell types, and analysis of cell abundance and gene expression.
prose.folds_in_note: Outline view only — no text sample provided, judgment rests on section headings. Explicit annotation sections present ('Annotation of the epithelial cells', 'Annotation of the stromal cells') plus named subsections (SOX9+ cells, Glandular cells, Luminal cells, Ciliated cells, MUC5B cells, eStromal cells, dStromal cells). These are robust signals for cell-type naming and characterization despite the absence of text.
